lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 生日快乐！这是给你的礼物。
lines.pinyin: Shēngrì kuàilè! Zhè shì gěi nǐ de lǐwù.
lines.english: Happy birthday! This is a gift for you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Wow, thanks! Let me open it and see.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 是一本中文书。适合初学者。
lines.pinyin: Shì yī běn Zhōngwén shū. Shìhé chūxuézhě.
lines.english: It's a Chinese book. Suitable for beginners.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 太完美了！我正想学中文呢。
lines.pinyin: Tài wánměi le! Wǒ zhèng xiǎng xué Zhōngwén ne.
lines.english: Too perfect! I was just wanting to learn Chinese.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 来，切蛋糕吧。大家一起唱歌。
lines.pinyin: Lái, qiē dàngāo ba. Dàjiā yīqǐ chànggē.
lines.english: Come, let's cut the cake. Everyone sing together.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Hǎo! Xǔyuàn, chuī làzhú, chī dàngāo!
lines.english: OK! Make a wish, blow candles, eat cake!

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 蛋糕很好吃。这是谁做的？
lines.pinyin: Dàngāo hěn hǎochī. Zhè shì shéi zuò de?
lines.english: The cake is delicious. Who made it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我妈妈做的。她做饭最好吃。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ māma zuò de. Tā zuòfàn zuì hǎochī.
lines.english: My mom made it. Her cooking is the best.
